[document summary] Projects/Mind Map.md serves as the bug‑tracker and feature‑request list for the Mind Map application. Its purpose is to document development issues, priorities, and planned enhancements. It contains no current bugs. Priority items include removing GitHub history for deleted/encrypted files, enabling MCP connections, adding URL scraping, integrating wiki links with the graph, implementing a smart chunking strategy, providing an inline AI edit feature, creating a custom markdown editor, and adding an undo/redo system. The list also references related projects within the Projects folder.
